name: Emrakul-Touched Monsters
description: Scores of bulbous, contorted creatures mutated by Emrakul and held in Nahiri's vault.

timeline.summary: Nahiri rotates the hall and opens a wall, releasing scores of Emrakul-touched monsters.
timeline.quote: Scores of monsters, bulbous and contorted, with only vague hints at the people and animals they had once been.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
timeline.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

pages_say.description: Scores of bulbous, contorted creatures mutated by Emrakul and held in Nahiri's vault.
